findings.reason: the brief is exact, so the node either deviates and reports a blocker or lands a red census; the plan must name the family by its registry key and put the census/partition edit in §5's done-when.
findings.text: §5 says the new family `station-store-not-node-local` is "registered with its remedy in `reckon/crew/refusals.py`", but that file's registry `DISPATCH_REFUSAL_REMEDIES` is keyed by `D##` codes only and `tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py:91` asserts `set(DISPATCH_REFUSAL_REMEDIES) == {D01…D23}` exactly (verified green here: 34 passed in `tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py`), so a node following the plan literally turns a currently-passing test red — adding the slug as a key or as `D24` both fail — and §5's done-when names no refusal test or census edit at all

findings.reason: the node would ship a refusal family advertised as covering the eight shared types that cannot fire for the root the plan tells it to use, and would prove it with a done-when that passes on a path outside those prefixes, so the guard must be applied to the root itself (the root's own type tested against `_SHARED_FILESYSTEMS`, not the union check) and §5's done-when must exercise that root.
findings.text: §5 claims the guard "reads the mount type through `_filesystem_type` against `_SHARED_FILESYSTEMS`, so all eight shared types are refused", but `host._is_node_local` returns `True` from `_dispatch._path_is_tmpfs` or `_dispatch._is_node_local_path` *before* it ever consults the filesystem argument (`reckon/host.py:190`–`192`), and `_is_node_local_path` matches `/run/user/…` and `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/…` by text prefix alone (`reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1646`–`1655`) while `_path_is_tmpfs` reads the real `/proc/self/mountinfo` and cannot be steered by the `_filesystem_type` patch §5's done-when prescribes — so a store root under `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` or `/run/user/<uid>` is accepted even when it sits on a shared filesystem, which is exactly the root `_session_host_runtime_root` returns first and the case §5's WAL argument exists to refuse
